The '''2022 [[Eliteserien]]''' was the 78th <!-- completed -->season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in Norway. This was the sixth season of Eliteserien after rebranding from Tippeligaen. [[Molde_FK|Molde]] were crowned the champions at the end of the season, winning their 5th Norwegian league title.

The season started on 2 April 2022 and ended on 13 November 2022, not including play-off matches.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fotball.no/tema/nff-nyheter/2021/hovedterminliste-menn-og-kvinner-2022/|title=Hovedterminliste menn og kvinner 2022|work=Norwegian Football Federation|date=2 November 2021|access-date=15 December 2021|language=no}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eliteserien.no/nyheter/her-er-spilleplanen-for-eliteserien-2022|title=Her er spilleplanen for Eliteserien 2022|work=Eliteserien|date=14 January 2022|access-date=20 January 2022|language=no}}</ref>

[[FK Bodø/Glimt|Bodø/Glimt]] were the defending champions, having won the [[2021 Eliteserien|previous season]]. [[HamKam]], [[Aalesunds FK|Aalesund]] and [[FK Jerv|Jerv]] joined as the promoted clubs from the [[2021 Norwegian First Division]]. They replaced [[SK Brann|Brann]], [[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]] and [[Mjøndalen IF Fotball|Mjøndalen]] who were relegated to the [[2022 Norwegian First Division|First Division]].

==Teams==
Sixteen teams competed in the league in this season – the top thirteen teams from the [[2021 Eliteserien|previous season]], and three teams promoted from the [[2021 Norwegian First Division|First Division]]. The promoted teams were [[HamKam]] (returning to the top flight after a thirteen season absence), [[Aalesunds FK|Aalesund]] (returning to the top flight after a one season absence) and [[FK Jerv|Jerv]] (first season in the top flight). They replaced [[SK Brann|Brann]], [[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]] and [[Mjøndalen IF Fotball|Mjøndalen]], ending their top flight spells of six, eight and three years respectively.

==Relegation play-offs==
<!--{{Main|2022 Eliteserien Promotion/relegation play-offs}}-->
[[Sandefjord Fotball|Sandefjord]], the 14th-placed team in Eliteserien defeated [[Kongsvinger IL Toppfotball|Kongsvinger]], the winners of the [[2022 Norwegian First Division#Promotion play-offs|First Division promotion play-offs]] 5-2 (aggregate) over two legs to qualify to remain in the Eliteserien in the [[2023 Eliteserien|following season]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fotball.no/tema/nff-nyheter/2022/slik-spilles-kvalifiseringskampene/|title=Slik spilles kvalifiseringskampene|work=Norwegian Football Federation|date=31 October 2022|access-date=31 October 2022|language=no}}</ref>
